<description>
Add direct unit tests in `script_tests`, `sigopcount_tests`, `script_standard_tests`, and `script_segwit_tests` covering edge cases in `src/script/script.cpp`.

These tests cover strict 34-byte Taproot script recognition and non-minimal pushdata rejection (killing surviving mutant 2347 from mutation run 21), outer `scriptSig` opcode parsing for `OP_16` and `OP_NOP` in `CScript::GetSigOpCount`, single-byte mismatches against the 2-byte anchor payload `{0x4e, 0x73}`, truncated length field handling in `GetScriptOp` for `OP_PUSHDATA4` (killing surviving mutant 2383), `MAX_OPCODE` boundary checks in `HasValidOps` (killing surviving mutant 2365), and delimiter formatting for single-element witness stacks in `CScriptWitness::ToString` (killing surviving mutant 2362).
</description>

[2026-10-08] c:6060188064 comment by Yudis-bit:
Fair point. I used an LLM earlier to draft the environment summary and format the text, which resulted in nonsensical toolchain versions and sloppy claims about the mutation run. That was a bad call, apologies for the noise.

On the code itself, Bruno's critique on b9ad09fe3 was accurate: placing `OP_16` inside the serialized redeem script left only a pushdata in `scriptSig`, never touching the `opcode > OP_16` guard at line 198 of `src/script/script.cpp`. Commit 6c82c93763 fixes that by placing `OP_16` directly in `scriptSig` ahead of the redeem script push, so a `>=` mutation drops the sigop count from 3 to 0.

On the mutation run 21 dataset, my claim that all 12 were live was wrong. Checking the data directly, only four are actual surviving mutants on master: 2347 (P2TR 34-byte check), 2362 (`CScriptWitness::ToString` delimiter on single elements), 2365 (`HasValidOps` ceiling at `MAX_OPCODE`), and 2383 (`GetScriptOp` truncated `OP_PUSHDATA4`). Mutants 2377 and 2380 were already caught elsewhere on master, while 2372 at line 322 (`end - pc < 1`) is unreachable dead code in `script.cpp` due to the preceding `pc >= end` guard at line 318.

The branch adds targeted unit test coverage for these boundaries across `script_segwit_tests` (Taproot push opcodes and size), `sigopcount_tests` (outer `scriptSig` `OP_16`), `script_standard_tests` (2-byte anchor mismatches on `{0x4e, 0x73}`), and `script_tests` (truncated pushdata headers and witness stringification). I have updated the PR description to remove the generated text.
</new_statements>
